//: Merge into <project>/.tabnine/agent/settings.json (or ~/.tabnine/agent/settings.json). enableAgents turns on the twin-builder subagent. Both hooks are one-liners; neither is a script of ours. Needs jq.
//prompt-log: BeforeAgent fires on every prompt the developer submits. This records it (skipping slash commands) to .git/qc-prompts/<branch>.md — per branch, never committed — so /done and /quality-review can build the twin's brief from what was actually asked, however many prompts it took. Delete the file to forget a branch.
//build-checks: AfterAgent fires once when the agent finishes a turn — never per tool call. Runs the repo's OWN build checks; on failure returns decision=deny so the agent sees the output and keeps working. Swap the gradle task for your build (mvn -q verify).

hooks.name: build-checks
hooks.command: bash -c 'O=$(./gradlew -q check 2>&1) || jq -n --arg r "$O" '"'"'{decision:"deny",reason:("Build checks failed. Fix the code at the root cause — do not edit rulesets, thresholds or add suppressions.\n\n"+$r)}'"'"''
